tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List the 29 ML / NLP / CV / data-mining venues whose reviewer forms reviewpaper.ai models, with the overall score scale, whether the form is official or modeled, and links. Use get_review_form for the full form.

tools.name: get_review_form
tools.description: The exact reviewer form for a venue: every field in order with guidance, each score scale with its official labels, the author checklist, the area-chair meta-review, the rough acceptance bar and the venue's LLM policy. Accepts a slug, name or alias (e.g. 'iclr', 'NeurIPS', 'ACL Rolling Review', 'cvp

tools.name: list_deadlines
tools.description: Upcoming paper and abstract deadlines for ~64 ML, CV, NLP, robotics, speech, data-mining and AI conferences, soonest first, in AoE and ISO-8601 UTC. Projected (not yet announced) dates are excluded unless include_estimated is true.

tools.name: get_deadline
tools.description: Full timeline for one conference edition: abstract/registration, paper, author response and decision dates (AoE + ISO), plus links to its review form. Accepts 'cvpr-2027', 'CVPR 2027' or just 'CVPR' (next upcoming edition).

tools.name: iclr_acceptance_odds
tools.description: Historical ICLR acceptance rate for papers with similar reviewer ratings, from public OpenReview decisions (kernel estimate over past score profiles). Give 3–6 ratings as the reviewers gave them. Not a prediction of any decision.

tools.name: convert_score
tools.description: Map an overall review score at one venue to the same position on other venues' scales, keeping its distance from each venue's rough acceptance bar. A heuristic for intuition, not an official equivalence.

tools.name: get_llm_policy
tools.description: What a venue allows authors and reviewers to do with LLMs, with the official policy link. Use before advising someone on AI use for a submission or a review.
